children: Deepsigma has launched a real-time simulated trading platform for perpetual contracts covering 77 traditional financial markets. According to Odaily, the platform includes U.S. stocks, equity indexes, commodities and U.S. Treasury yields, and supports long and short exposure to the assets. It is built on the Cypherium blockchain by a team whose members are alumni of Goldman Sachs, Citadel Securities, Google and Uber.

The contracts track prices through external data sources and do not tokenize, custody or physically deliver the underlying assets. Supported markets include the S&P 500, Dow Jones Industrial Average, Nasdaq Composite, Russell 2000, Cboe Volatility Index, crude oil, gold, silver, natural gas and copper.

The platform’s risk engine uses multiple external price sources, mark prices, circuit breakers, partial liquidations and an insurance fund. A central limit order book and settlement layer handle margin, collateral and settlement. Deepsigma is also developing a decentralized identity framework based on zero-knowledge proofs and uses off-chain AI analysis tools without fund-execution authority. Cypherium uses a hybrid proof-of-work and HotStuff Byzantine fault-tolerant consensus mechanism and holds four U.S. patents.

title: Deepsigma Launches DeFi Perpetuals Platform Covering 77 Traditional Markets
